papers.title: The interaction of surface stiffness and hopping frequency on the metabolic cost and biomechanics of human hopping
papers.abstract: Metabolic cost reductions for stationary hopping on elastic compared with rigid surfaces are frequency dependent. We found that the surface stiffness that minimized metabolic cost was stiffer at faster hopping frequencies. Leg stiffness and contact time increased as surface stiffness decreased, and this effect was amplified at faster hopping frequencies. These findings suggest that the stiffness of passive-elastic devices, like elastic surfaces and footwear, should be tuned to movement frequency to minimize metabolic cost.

papers.abstract_zh: 运动鞋行业正从传统的线性研发流程转向由人工智能驱动的先进数字化工作流。本文评估人工智能工具如何优化既有制造范式，关注运动鞋开发中系统性的转型而非孤立的技术突破。然而传统流程存在概念迭代效率低、有限元仿真耗时长、模具成本高等瓶颈，阻碍了大规模定制，本研究着手分析人工智能如何应对这些挑战。

papers.abstract: Ultra-low-density elastomeric foams enable lightweight systems that combine high compliance with efficient energy return. Their mechanical response is inherently complex, characterized by high compressibility, nonlinear elasticity, and microstructural heterogeneity. papers.title_zh: 探索超低密度弹性体泡沫在精英级赛车鞋中的力学原理

papers.title: Rocker Geometry in Running Footwear: A Scoping Review of Definitions, Commercial Descriptors and Outcome Measures
papers.venue: Journal of foot and ankle research
papers.abstract: BackgroundRockered midsoles are increasingly used in running footwear, yet definitions, terminology and outcome measures vary widely across research and commercial sectors.AimThis scoping review mapped how rockers are defined in academic literature, how major footwear brands describe them and which outcome measures are most frequently evaluated.MethodsA scoping review was conducted using systematic searches of four academic databases, identifying 19 eligible studies. papers.title_zh: 跑步鞋中的弧形鞋底几何形状：对定义、商业描述和结果指标的范围综述
papers.abstract_zh: 摇板中底在跑鞋中的应用日益广泛，但其定义、术语和结局指标在研究界和商业界存在很大差异。目的本范围综述旨在梳理学术文献中对摇板的定义、主要鞋履品牌对摇板的描述，以及最常评估的结局指标。方法通过对四个学术数据库进行系统检索，开展范围综述，识别 19项符合条件的研究。 还对八大领先鞋类品牌的商业材料进行了研究，以评估对弧形底特征的非学术性描述。结果：学术文献使用了多种术语和几何描述，如顶点位置、弧形底角度、曲率半径和前掌翘起，但未找到用于分类弧形底的一致定义或阈值。商业描述依赖于定性的品牌专用语言

papers.title: Exploring the Role of Footwear in Trail Running and Hiking: A Scoping Review
papers.venue: Journal of foot and ankle research
papers.abstract: IntroductionOff-road activities such as trail running and hiking have undergone a significant surge in global popularity over the last 2 decades, but this engagement also raises the potential for musculoskeletal injuries, which are prevalent and comparable to rates reported in road running. Footwear is critical in these dynamic environments, incorporating features such as aggressive outsole patterns and structural stability elements to accommodate varied and rugged terrain.MethodsGiven the limited synthesis and fragmented nature of the literature, this scoping review systematically mapped and summarised existing research on the influence of footwear in hiking and trail running. The review was guided by three research questions that examined key outcome domains and methodological approaches, using the Arksey and O'Malley framework, and was reported in accordance with PRISMA-ScR guidelines

papers.abstract_zh: 引言在过去20年里，越野跑和徒步旅行等越野活动在全球的受欢迎程度显著上升，但参与这些活动也增加了发生肌肉骨骼损伤的可能性，此类损伤十分常见，其发生率与公路跑步的报道率相当。 在这些多变的户外环境中，鞋履至关重要，其具备的抓地力强劲的外底花纹和结构稳定性等特性，能够适应多样且崎岖的地形。方法鉴于文献的综述有限且分散零碎，本范围综述对有关鞋履在徒步和越野跑中影响的现有研究进行了系统梳理和总结。 该综述以三个研究问题为指导，使用Arksey和O'Malley框架，对关键结果领域和方法学方法进行了研究，并根据PRISMA-ScR指南进行了报告。

papers.venue: Journal of foot and ankle research
papers.abstract: BackgroundDiabetes-related foot ulceration (DFU) is a serious complication that can lead to lower limb amputation or death. Custom-made footwear is a key preventative strategy, yet adherence to use is often low.
